  PROBLEM: The new `_std_cached_head_sha` variable is declared but can still contain an empty string when GraphQL payloads provide `null` or empty values for head SHA, leading to JSON serialization that omits the field even when the intent is to preserve it.
  WHY: This will cause the cache to not differ between empty and legitimate SHAs, and downstream code that expects `head_sha` to be present when non-empty GraphQL data exists will incorrectly fall back to REST.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10554 | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The jq expression generating the cached JSON uses an object spread to conditionally include `sha`, but when `$hs` is empty or null, the object spread evaluates to an empty object `{}` instead of an explicit `null` or omitting the key entirely, which can cause downstream consumers to misinterpret the structure.
  WHY: The generated JSON will have an inconsistent shape (`head:{}` vs `head:null` vs missing key) depending on whether the GraphQL payload supplied an empty value or true null, which breaks contract expectations in other parts of the codebase that grep for `"head.sha"` or `"head_sha"`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10554 and 16794/16826 | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The test suite exercises only the mock `gh` binary path and does not assert that a real `workflow_dispatch` review-autofix run with blank `head_branch` is correctly recognized as "in-flight" by the standalone-stall-recovery sweep when the subsequent REST `pulls/{n}` re-fetch genuinely fails.
  WHY: A transient GitHub API error on the fallback REST call after a GraphQL-sourced cache miss would allow the empty-commit push race to fire again, defeating the exact race the `head.sha` seeding and `GET`-only mock guard were added to close.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:~5518-5540 | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]

  WHY: The test can pass while the end-to-end noop-suspicious recovery path still races an in-flight review-autofix `workflow_dispatch` run (or silently updates the comment when it should not).
